paper: FinVision: A Multi-Agent Framework for Stock Market Prediction
headline_strategy: LangGraph multi-agent daily trading system in which GPT-4o-mini agents summarize news, analyze 60-day technical charts, and form short/medium reflections before an o1-mini prediction agent issues BUY/SELL/HOLD plus a 1-10 position size
paper_portability_to_common_task: not defensibly executable because only manuscript prompts are released, with no system code, frozen inputs, actions, or portfolio accounting
missing_headline_objects: LangGraph implementation, dependency lock, runnable configuration and data pipeline
the original Yahoo/EODHD news rows, query parameters, timestamps, timezone and deduplication
the exact price snapshot, adjusted/unadjusted field, chart inputs and indicator implementation
immutable GPT-4o-mini/o1-mini snapshots, seeds, request IDs, requests and responses
daily BUY/SELL/HOLD actions, position sizes, fills, rewards, cash ledger and equity trajectory
trade timing, share rounding, long/short constraints, costs, slippage and cash equations
a paper-defined cross-sectional portfolio adapter for the monthly top-1,000 JKP universe

rejected_substitutes.route: Render the five prompt templates with invented runtime values
rejected_substitutes.reason: Templates without the original inputs, requests, model snapshots, responses and orchestration do not recover the decision policy.
The raster image is not an exact action, position, cash or equity record and cannot identify daily holdings.
Only 3 of 9 market cells match and the feed/metric convention has no paper-time lineage or FinVision credit.
Those nine cells are externally transcribed baseline results, including one nonstandard truncation, and are not FinVision actions.

rejected_substitutes.route: Build a new monthly JKP chart/news agent
rejected_substitutes.reason: JKP does not contain the required point-in-time news, and replacing the unavailable models, runtime traces, execution rules and portfolio would create a new system.

result_policy: No prompt-only simulation, raster reconstruction, current-market diagnostic, FinAgent baseline, or invented JKP agent is entered as a FinVision return. The positive paper results remain unresolved rather than classified as false or as JKP underperformance.
